resultSubtitle: KPIs, transactions and cost centers for the selected period
printReportTooltip: Print / save this month's report as PDF

defaultModal.title: Default rate
defaultModal.subtitle: Unpaid bills, taxes and cost center expenses
defaultModal.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
defaultModal.rate: {pct}% of the period's pending amount is overdue

projection.title: Projected balance
projection.subtitle: Today's balance plus what is expected from open receivables and payables
projection.aria: Line chart of the projected balance for the next 30 days
projection.overduePayIncluded: {count, plural, one {# overdue payable is} other {# overdue payables are}} included in the projection:
projection.overdueRecExcluded: {count, plural, one {# overdue receivable is} other {# overdue receivables are}} left out of the projection:
projection.rule: Only the open balance counts (what was already settled is in cash, so nothing is counted twice). Overdue receivables are not assumed to be collected.

states.errorWhat: Could not load {what}. Values are hidden so they don't mislead you.

cards.balanceNote: Inflows minus outflows already realized, up to today.
cards.vsEquivalent: vs. same span of the previous month
cards.vsEquivalentYear: vs. same span of the previous year
cards.notBalance: Result is not the bank balance: it only counts realized revenue and expenses.
cards.outsideResult: Investments, redemptions, loans and transfers between accounts are left out.
cards.noAlertsNote: No warning conditions in the current data.

evolution.resultSubtitleMonth: Cumulative result day by day in {period}
evolution.resultSubtitleYear: Cumulative result month by month in {period}
evolution.resultNote: Result = realized revenue − expenses. Excludes investments, loans and transfers.
evolution.resultAria: Line chart of the cumulative result in {period}
evolution.flowSubtitleMonth: By week of the month in {period}
evolution.flowAria: Column chart of inflows and outflows in {period}
evolution.empty: No realized movements in this period.

budgetSection.title: Budget: planned × actual
budgetSection.subtitle: Cost centers, bills and taxes for {period}
budgetSection.empty: No budget or bills due in this period.
budgetSection.rule: Budgeted = cost-center budgets + bills and taxes due in the period. Actual = paid cost-center expenses + the portion of bills and taxes actually paid.

dueSection.paySubtitle: Overdue, due today and due in the next {days} days
dueSection.recSubtitle: Late, due today and due in the next {days} days
dueSection.overdueDays: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
dueSection.payEmpty: No payables overdue or due soon.
dueSection.recEmpty: No receivables late or expected soon.

centersSection.title: Cost centers: highlights
centersSection.subtitle: Largest paid expenses in {period}
centersSection.empty: No paid cost-center expenses in this period.
centersSection.overCount: {count, plural, one {# center over budget} other {# centers over budget}}
centersSection.noBudget: No budget set for the period

alertsSection.title: Alert center
alertsSection.subtitle: Generated from real conditions in your data, without repetition
alertsSection.none: No alerts for this period. Everything is within the criteria.
alertsSection.criteria: Criteria: budget from {budget}% used; revenue drop from {drop}% and expense rise from {rise}% against the equivalent previous period; reconciliation becomes a warning from {recon}% pending. Overdue bills are always critical.
alertsSection.noMarginTarget: No margin target is configured, so there is no margin alert.
alertsSection.noDivergence: Bank statement divergences are not checked yet.

negativeBalance.title: Negative cash balance
negativeBalance.reason: Realized cash is negative today: payments already made exceed the money received.

projectedNegative.title: Balance projected negative within {days} days
projectedNegative.reason: Considering open items (overdue and upcoming payables, minus expected receivables), the balance should turn negative within {days} days.

overduePayables.title: Overdue payables
overduePayables.reason: {count, plural, one {# open bill is past due} other {# open bills are past due}}, totaling {total}. Overdue does not mean paid.

dueTodayPayables.title: Payments due today
dueTodayPayables.reason: {count, plural, one {# payment is due today} other {# payments are due today}}, totaling {total}.

dueSoonPayables.title: Upcoming due dates
dueSoonPayables.reason: {count, plural, one {# payment is due} other {# payments are due}} in the next {days} days, totaling {total}.

overdueReceivables.title: Late receivables
overdueReceivables.reason: {count, plural, one {# charge is} other {# charges are}} late, totaling {total}. They are left out of the balance projection.

budgetExceeded.title: Budget exceeded
budgetExceeded.reason: Actual spending has used {pct}% of the budget in the period, {over} above plan.

budgetNearLimit.title: Budget near its limit
budgetNearLimit.reason: Actual spending has used {pct}% of the budget in the period (alert from {limit}%).

centersOver.title: Cost centers over budget
centersOver.reason: {count, plural, one {# center went} other {# centers went}} over the period budget.

reconPending.title: Unreconciled entries
reconPending.reason: {count, plural, one {# entry in the period is not reconciled yet} other {# entries in the period are not reconciled yet}} ({pct}% of the period), totaling {total}. Becomes a warning from {limit}%.

duplicateSuspects.title: Possible duplicate entries
duplicateSuspects.reason: {count, plural, one {# entry repeats} other {# entries repeat}} the type, date, amount and description of another, totaling {total}. Check before deleting.

negativeResult.title: Negative result for the period
negativeResult.reason: Expenses exceeded realized revenue (year-to-date result: {acc}). Excludes investments, loans and transfers.

revenueDrop.title: Revenue drop
revenueDrop.reason: Revenue fell {pct}% against the same span of the previous period (alert from {limit}%).

expenseRise.title: Expenses rising
expenseRise.reason: Expenses rose {pct}% against the same span of the previous period (alert from {limit}%).

marginBelowTarget.title: Margin below target
marginBelowTarget.reason: The period margin is {pct}%, below the {target}% target.
